about: Extensible style registry. status: native = engine + example render in styles/; adapted = recipe on a native engine, UNVERIFIED until a render passes QA (tools/qc.py); prompt-pack = prompts for user-run external tools. Add a style by appending an entry; run scripts/select_style.py --self-test.

styles.recipe: See styles/deep-dive/STYLE.md

styles.recipe: See styles/night-file/STYLE.md

styles.name: Cartoon animation
styles.recipe: Inside Out engine; widen palette in lib.js C, add 2-3 exaggerated expressions (squash/stretch via K.man scale), thick ink outline on everything.

styles.name: Minimalist character animation
styles.recipe: Stick Story engine; monochrome + one accent colour, no room details, generous negative space, slow eases.

styles.name: Whiteboard animation
styles.recipe: Stick Story engine on white #FAFAFA, black marker strokes drawn on progressively (stroke-dash reveal), 2 marker colours only.

styles.name: Modern 2D vector animation
styles.recipe: Inside Out engine; flat geometric shapes, 4-5 colour brand palette, rounded rectangles, no outlines on shapes.

styles.name: Cut-out animation
styles.recipe: Paper Atlas engine with jointed paper limbs (rotating pivots), visible paper edge shadow, slight jitter at 12 fps.

styles.name: Anime-inspired animation
styles.recipe: Inside Out engine; add speed lines, impact frames, hold frames with limited animation, big eye highlights, dramatic zoom-ins. Original characters only, no existing franchise designs.

styles.name: Traditional hand-drawn animation
styles.recipe: Inside Out engine; wobbly line (per-frame vertex jitter at 12 fps), pencil texture, imperfect colour fill offset from line.

styles.name: Frame-by-frame animation
styles.recipe: Render at 12 fps with deliberate per-frame redraw variance (line boil). Expensive to author; use only when the brief asks for it.

styles.name: Stylized 3D animation
styles.recipe: Tall Tale 3D engine: saturated palette, rounded 3D sets, characters stay 2D cut-outs (a fully 3D-modelled character rig is not available in this skill).

styles.name: Pixar-inspired aesthetic (original characters)
styles.recipe: Tall Tale 3D engine: warm key light + cool fill, soft bloom, shallow depth of field, big-eyed original characters, rounded props. Never copy existing characters or designs.

styles.name: Low-poly 3D animation
styles.recipe: Deep Dive engine with flatShading materials, no textures, 6-8 colour palette, simple directional light, no bloom.

styles.name: Clay-like 3D animation
styles.recipe: Deep Dive engine; soft roughness 0.9, fingerprint-noise bump map, rounded geometry, slightly low 12 fps stepped motion.

styles.name: Realistic 3D visualization
styles.recipe: Deep Dive engine with physically based materials, HDR environment, shadows at 2048+, shallow DoF. Needs a GPU for sane render times.

styles.name: Cinematic 3D animation
styles.recipe: Night File engine: single motivated key light, volumetric fog, anamorphic bloom, slow dolly, letterbox bars, teal-orange grade.

styles.name: 3D cartoon animation
styles.recipe: Tall Tale 3D engine as-is, bias toward faster cuts and more exaggerated mood states.

styles.name: Isometric animation
styles.recipe: Deep Dive engine with OrthographicCamera at 35.264/45 deg, flat shaded blocks, one accent colour, objects animate in by dropping/extruding.

styles.name: Paper-cut animation
styles.recipe: Paper Atlas engine as-is with theme palette swapped for non-history topics.

styles.name: Stop-motion animation
styles.recipe: Paper Atlas engine rendered at 8-12 fps with positional jitter and lighting flicker; hold poses for 2-3 frames.

styles.name: Claymation
styles.recipe: Same as clay-3d plus 12 fps stepped motion and thumbprint texture; deformation by squash/stretch.

styles.name: Puppet animation
styles.recipe: Paper Atlas engine with a proscenium stage frame, rods/strings visible from above, limited jointed motion.

styles.name: Watercolor animation
styles.recipe: Paper Atlas engine; replace flat fills with soft-edged washes (multi-pass blurred shapes), paper grain overlay, colour bleed on transitions.

styles.name: Sketch animation
styles.recipe: Stick Story engine; pencil strokes drawn on (dash reveal) over off-white paper, graphite grey + one highlight colour.

styles.name: Storybook illustration animation
styles.recipe: Paper Atlas engine; page-turn transitions, soft parallax layers, painterly textures, serif narration captions at bottom.

styles.name: Comic-book animation
styles.recipe: Inside Out engine; halftone dot fills, thick ink, panel borders that reveal, onomatopoeia bursts, motion between panels.

styles.name: Pixel-art animation
styles.recipe: Inside Out engine drawn to a 270x480 offscreen canvas, nearest-neighbour upscaled x4, 16-colour palette, 8-12 fps.

styles.name: Silhouette animation
styles.recipe: Night File engine or Paper Atlas layers: black figures against coloured gradient backdrops, backlit, no facial detail.

styles.name: Mixed-media animation
styles.recipe: Paper Atlas base with 2 other textures (pencil, halftone) following hybrid rules in library/hybrids.json.

styles.name: Motion graphics
styles.recipe: Inside Out engine without hero character; shapes, icons, counters, wipes, grid layouts; brand palette.

styles.name: Kinetic typography
styles.recipe: Inside Out engine captions system promoted to the main visual: word-by-word scale/rotate, big type, background colour shifts on beat.

styles.name: Animated infographic video
styles.recipe: Inside Out engine; charts drawn from data (bars grow, lines draw, counters tick), one takeaway per shot.

styles.name: Explainer animation
styles.recipe: Inside Out engine; problem -> mechanism -> result structure, icons + simple hero.

styles.name: Animated storytelling
styles.recipe: Pick the engine by genre; this entry is the generic narrative structure from reference/storytelling.md.

styles.name: Character-based storytelling
styles.recipe: Tall Tale 3D if budget allows, else Inside Out/Stick Story with a locked character bible.

styles.name: Loop animation
styles.recipe: Inside Out engine; design shot so frame at t=0 equals frame at t=duration; no voice or sparse text; 6-15 s.

styles.name: Cinematic animated reel
styles.recipe: Night File engine with warmer grade; letterbox, slow push-ins, typography titles, music-led pacing.

styles.name: Dynamic text-and-image animation
styles.recipe: Inside Out engine; supplied images with Ken Burns moves and animated text callouts. Images must be user-supplied or original code art.

styles.name: Parallax animation
styles.recipe: Paper Atlas layered cut-outs moved at different speeds on camera pan; 4-6 depth layers.

styles.name: AI-assisted visual animation (prompt pack)
styles.recipe: The skill does NOT generate images or video. It writes a scene-by-scene prompt pack with a locked character bible for the user to run in their own tools, then can assemble the returned clips with ffmpeg + captions + audio.
styles.note: Only when the user asks for it explicitly.
